sections.label: Your fear:
sections.text: Being ordinary. You dream big but deep down you're scared you'll never live up to what you know you're capable of. You set impossible standards because mediocrity feels like death, but the pressure is crushing you. You are terrified that one day you'll wake up and realise you played it safe.

sections.label: Your power:
sections.text: You don't just dream, you build empires from nothing. When everyone else is waiting for permission, you're already three steps ahead making it happen. The fire in you doesn't burn out, it only burns brighter when people doubt you.

slides.title: Scorpio
bullets: You test people by pulling away and calling it a standard.
You confuse intensity with intimacy more often than you admit.
You'd rather be feared than misread, and it costs you every time.
You forgive people privately and never tell them you did.

sections.label: Your Toxic Attraction:
sections.text: You attract people who fall for your softness and then test how much of it they can take. They love your tenderness until it asks something of them. You keep choosing people who are deep on paper and gone in practice. You give them a home. They treat it like a hotel.

sections.label: What You Really Need:
sections.text: Someone who chooses you out loud and keeps choosing you. A partner who is present, not just poetic. You need love that shows up, not love you have to decode. You do not need a mystery. You need a person who stays when the softness gets real.

slides.title: Leo
bullets: You mistake being needed for being wanted.
You give people the version of you they applaud, then resent them for not knowing the rest.
You would rather burn out loudly than fade quietly.
You have never once asked for reassurance out loud.

sections.label: The wound:
sections.text: You don't cry the way people expect. You go quiet. The fire that fills every room just goes out, and for the first time in your life you don't want to be seen. You keep it moving, keep it busy, keep it loud on the outside. But at night the silence is deafening.

sections.label: The healing:
sections.text: It comes the day you stop apologising for being too much. You learn the difference between too much and just too much for them. Somewhere in the quiet you find the fire again, and this time you don't dim it for anyone.

slides.title: March Girlfriend
bullets: She remembers exactly what you said three weeks ago at 2am
She forgives you faster than she should and knows it
She gives everyone the love she's still waiting to receive
She's not too sensitive, you're just used to women who gave up on feeling

sections.label: Don't settle for:
sections.text: Dimming yourself so someone else feels comfortable. Your whole life people have given you the "you're too much" look. Too loud. Too intense. Too fast. And somewhere along the way you started believing them.

sections.label: Wait for:
sections.text: The person who walks into your chaos and doesn't even blink. Who watches you hit full volume and just goes "yeah, that's my person." They won't try to calm you down. They'll hand you water and ask "okay, what's the plan."

slides.title: Libra
bullets: She apologises for things that were never hers to carry.
She notices everything and mentions almost none of it.
She wants to be chosen without having to ask to be.
She loves quietly, and assumes that counts as saying it.
